name: Sky Sliders for Elementor
author: wowDevs

sections.description:
Sky Sliders is a free Elementor slider plugin that gives you beautifully designed, ready-to-use slider widgets for WordPress. Drop a widget onto any Elementor page, add your images, customize colors and typography, and publish — no coding, no shortcodes, no page rebuilds.

Every Sky Sliders widget is built for performance — your image sliders are silky smooth, fully responsive, and swipe-ready on mobile, tablet, and desktop out of the box.

Free Slider Widgets

Minimal Slider
A clean, full-screen image slider for portfolios, agencies, and creative showcases. Each slide supports a sub-title, headline, body text, call-to-action button, featured image, and an optional video URL. Arrow navigation, dot pagination, autoplay, loop mode, and transition speed are all fully configurable inside the Elementor panel — no CSS required.

Photography Slider
An immersive, image-first slider built for photographers, studios, and visual storytellers. Each slide features a two-part title with an accent color span, a dramatic outline text layer, a full-bleed background image, and a clickable link. A built-in social links sidebar and numbered slide pagination complete the design.

Advanced Slider
A feature-rich, multi-layer hero slider built for landing pages and high-impact sections. Supports multiple content layers per slide with independent animation controls, making it ideal for bold, conversion-focused hero areas.

Fluid Slider
A full-viewport slider with a distinctive frosted-glass circular overlay on each slide. Supports headline, description, CTA button, and floating badge elements — perfect for agencies and digital studios.

Vibrant Slider
A dark, high-impact hero slider with large headline, subtitle, body text, pill-style CTA button, and smooth progress-bar pagination. Designed for portfolios, creative agencies, and product showcases.

Why Thousands of Elementor Users Choose Sky Sliders

  • True drag-and-drop — find the slider widget in the Elementor panel and place it anywhere on any page or post.
  • Fully responsive slider — every widget adapts flawlessly to desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.
  • Touch & swipe support — native-feeling touch gestures on all iOS and Android devices.
  • Pixel-perfect Elementor controls — adjust colors, typography, spacing, borders, and slider height directly inside Elementor.
  • Independent autoplay & loop — set autoplay delay and slide transition speed per widget, independently.
  • Toggleable navigation & pagination — show or hide arrow buttons and dot indicators per widget.
  • Correct heading hierarchy — choose H1–H6, div, span, or p for slide titles to match your page’s SEO structure.
  • Zero global overhead — slider CSS and JS load only on pages that actually use a Sky Sliders widget.
  • Clean uninstall — removing the plugin leaves no orphaned data, shortcodes, or broken layouts.

Pro Slider Widgets

Unlock three additional premium Elementor slider widgets with Sky Sliders Pro:

  • Creative — bold full-bleed slider with centered overlapping text and image layers, subtle corner frame details, and dot pagination.
  • Elegant Carousel — refined vertical and horizontal multi-item carousel with smooth center-focus animation and slide numbering.
  • Lucid — high-contrast typographic slider with bold diagonal accent blocks, ideal for construction, architecture, and corporate sites.

Upgrade to Sky Sliders Pro →

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or later
  • Elementor 3.0.0 or later (free or Pro)
  • PHP 7.4 or later
sections.installation:
Option 1 — WordPress Plugin Directory (recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Sky Sliders.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Option 2 — Manual upload

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now, then Activate.

Option 3 — FTP

  1. Extract the ZIP and upload the sky-sliders-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.

Using the widgets

  1. Open any page or post in Elementor.
  2. Search for “Minimal” or “Photography” in the Elementor widget panel.
  3. Drag the widget onto your layout.
  4. Add your slides, images, titles, and links in the Content tab.
  5. Style colors, typography, and spacing in the Style tab.
  6. Publish.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No. Sky Sliders is an Elementor add-on and requires Elementor (free or Pro) to be installed and active. The slider widgets will not appear in the widget panel without it.

Which version of Elementor is required?

Elementor 3.0.0 or later. Both the free and Pro versions of Elementor are fully supported.

Is this a free Elementor slider plugin?

Yes. Sky Sliders includes two fully featured slider widgets — Minimal Slider and Photography Slider — completely free, with no feature limits, no nag screens, and no account required.

Will my image sliders work on mobile?

Yes. Every widget is fully responsive with native-feeling touch-swipe support on all iOS and Android devices.

Can I use this as a hero slider or full-screen slider?

Yes. Both free widgets are designed for full-screen or full-width hero sections. The Minimal Slider and Photography Slider both span the full viewport width and can be set to any height using the Slider Height control in px, vh, em, or rem.

How do I create an image carousel in Elementor?

Install Sky Sliders, open a page in Elementor, search for “Minimal” or “Photography” in the widget panel, drag the widget onto your page, and add your slides in the Content tab. For a multi-item carousel layout, upgrade to Sky Sliders Pro and use the Elegant Carousel widget.

How do I add autoplay to a slider?

Select the widget in Elementor, go to the Settings tab in the widget panel, and toggle Autoplay on. You can then set the Autoplay Speed (delay between slides) and Slide Speed (transition duration) independently per widget.

Can I change the slide height?

Yes. Each widget includes a Slider Height control in the Additional Settings section. You can set any value in px, vh, em, or rem directly from the Elementor panel.

Does Sky Sliders slow down pages that don’t use the widget?

No. Styles and scripts are registered globally but only enqueued by Elementor on pages that contain at least one Sky Sliders widget, keeping every other page completely unaffected.

Can I use Sky Sliders and Sky Sliders Pro at the same time?

No — installing Sky Sliders Pro automatically deactivates the free plugin to avoid conflicts. All your existing slider content is preserved and Pro is fully backward-compatible with the free version.

Where can I report a bug or request a feature?

Please open an issue on our GitHub repository or use the support forum on this plugin’s WordPress.org page.

1.0.3 [22th May 2026]

  • Improved plugin structure and build pipeline.
  • Per-widget asset loading — CSS and JS only load on pages using the widget.
  • Text domain corrected for WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Fixed wp_redirect() replaced with wp_safe_redirect() in duplicator utility.
  • Code quality improvements for WordPress Plugin Check compliance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with Minimal and Photography slider widgets.
